content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Nicobar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit Nicobar (DCPU Nicobar) for filling various vacant positions in Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available across various posts including Counsellor, Accountant, Outreach Worker, Assistant cum Data Entry Operator, Nurse, Doctor, Chowkidar, and Ayah.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30-09-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DCPU Nicobar Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates need to fill out the prescribed application form and send it via postal or physical submission to the specified authority.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7,944 to Rs. 18,536 per month depending on the specific post you are applying for under the DCPU Nicobar establishment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts advertised under this recruitment notification is set at 50 years. Refer to the official notice for any relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for the Ayah post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Ayah post must have passed the Secondary School Examination (Xth) standard from a recognized board along with 01 year of experience as an Ayah or female attendant.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Interview and Document Verification round for shortlisted candidates based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form by clicking the respective direct links provided in the Important Links section of this article.
